newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian gilt prices steady in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Indian gilt prices steady in quiet trade.

text.p: * Prices of government securities steady in quiet afternoon trade Thursday, with most deals done in latest government stock 12.14 percent 2000, dealers said.
* The 12.14 percent 2000 stock, auctioned on Wednesday, traded at par with stray deals below par, they said.
"But these may be arranged deals between primary dealers and banks," said one dealer. "Primary dealers may be passing on commission to the banks."
Wednesday's auction was the last one in which primary dealers got a one percent commission on government securities purchased by them in the primary market.
Dealers said primary dealers bid at low yields at Wednesday's auction as they had the one percent commission as a cushion.
* In latest deals, the 12.69 percent 2002 traded at 100.40 and 100.42 rupees against last traded 100.36. April 24, 1998 treasury bill traded steady at a yield of 9.5 percent.
* Dealers said a four-day repo was done at 7.5 percent.
